end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group to make a close estimate without counting every item. Ananya explained that an estimate is a close guess and later answered “around thirty” for three handfuls. They initially counted groups as single objects, and this was corrected later; the idea that spreading objects out makes more of them remained to revisit. At home, place a small known group of items beside a larger collection and ask for an estimate before counting.
